headline: Voted to enter executive session to review applicants for City Council Budget/Management Analyst position.
summary: The committee met to screen applicants for the City Council Budget/Management Analyst position. The chair found that an open meeting would hurt efforts to get qualified applicants, so the committee voted to go into executive session and adjourn directly from it without reconvening in open session.
decisions: Voted 3-0 to enter executive session to review resumes and applications for the Budget/Management Analyst position.

decision_evidence.quote: Rotondo moves to enter Executive Session; Spang seconds; Houseman takes a roll-call vote (Rotondo-yes; Spang-yes; Houseman-yes), and the motion carries 3-0 at 2:03 p.m.
